headline_marked: Dramatic comeback: [[Belgium beat Senegal 3-2]] to reach World Cup last 16
headline: Dramatic comeback: Belgium beat Senegal 3-2 to reach World Cup last 16
summary: After trailing by two goals, Belgium scored three late goals including a 125th-minute penalty to secure their spot in the knockout stages.
details: Belgium secured a place in the World Cup Round of 16 after a dramatic 3-2 victory over Senegal on Wednesday.
Senegal dominated much of the match, taking a 2-0 lead with goals from Habib Diarra in the 25th minute and Ismaila Sarr in the 51st minute.
Belgium's comeback began in the 86th minute when substitute Romelu Lukaku scored, followed by captain Youri Tielemans equalising less than three minutes later to force extra time.
The match was decided in the 125th minute when Youri Tielemans converted a penalty after being fouled in the box.
Belgium will now face the winner of the match between the United States and Bosnia and Herzegovina in Seattle on July 6 for a place in the quarter-finals.
caption:
Down 2-0 until the 86th minute, Belgium pulled off a miracle comeback to knock Senegal out of the World Cup!

Belgium secured a place in the World Cup Round of 16 after a dramatic 3-2 victory over Senegal on Wednesday.

Senegal dominated much of the match, taking a 2-0 lead with goals from Habib Diarra in the 25th minute and Ismaila Sarr in the 51st minute.

Belgium's comeback began in the 86th minute when substitute Romelu Lukaku scored, followed by captain Youri Tielemans equalising less than three minutes later to force extra time.

The match was decided in the 125th minute when Youri Tielemans converted a penalty after being fouled in the box.

Belgium will now face the winner of the match between the United States and Bosnia and Herzegovina in Seattle on July 6 for a place in the quarter-finals.

headline_marked: 2 workers [[killed by lightning strike]] in Tangail
headline: 2 workers killed by lightning strike in Tangail
summary: The tragedy occurred as the laborers were working in the open during a sudden storm.
details: Two laborers were killed after being struck by lightning in Tangail district.
The incident occurred while the workers were performing their duties in an open area during a sudden weather change.
Local authorities and emergency responders were alerted to the incident, which has left the community in shock.
Lightning strikes are a recurring danger for outdoor workers in Bangladesh during the pre-monsoon and monsoon seasons.
